english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something highly valued or personally dear.
Use this when something is valuable because it is rare, precious, or greatly treasured.

examples.english: This old photo is a cherished keepsake for me.
examples.traditional: 呢張舊相對我嚟講好珍貴。

examples.english: This photo is very valuable to me.
examples.traditional: 呢張相對我嚟講好珍貴。
